blurb: Air Heritage Aviation Museum is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that is run by unpaid volunteers who have a passion for aviation and a dedication to preserve its history. We are 100% dependent on donations and fundraisers to keep our museum doors open “free to the public” and to keep our Warbirds flying for generations to come! Please consider donating today.
